thread:
Alex Support: Escalating — Acme (enterprise) reporting intermittent 502s and auth failures this morning, plus missing KMS access events in their audit logs. They also saw a billing spike. Need triage + ISO27001 mapping for audit/KMS controls.
Acme Ops (customer): Hey team, between 08:12-08:45 UTC we saw ~30 502s and a few 403s. Our app logs show: `ERR_KMS_AUTH` referencing key `rk-prod-42`. Also our billing dashboard spiked at 08:20. We can't find corresponding KMS access entries in the audit export.
Jordan Oncall: Can you paste the app error lines and the request id from our API responses? I'll pull service traces.
Acme Ops (customer): snippet: ```2026-03-15T08:18:04Z ERROR request failed id=01E9X2 tx=abc123 status=502 msg="upstream: KMS auth failed" details="ERR_KMS_AUTH key=rk-prod-42"``` Request-id from our client header: `rwd-rq-20260315-07a2`.
Alex Support: Repro steps I just ran against their tenant (short): ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-key>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello"}'``` Response intermittently: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` or `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` with body `{"error":"KMS token fetch failed"}`. Latency 700-1200ms when failing.
Jordan Oncall: I pulled internal traces for request id `rwd-rq-20260315-07a2` — KMS token service returned `401` for a short window 08:15:30-08:18:20 UTC, retries exhausted and we returned 502 to customer. HSM proxy logs show sessions created but several `auth: denied` entries.
Priya Security: Thanks — two asks: 1) we need to confirm whether the missing KMS audit entries are due to export ingestion lag or dropped events; 2) customer is asking for ISO27001 evidence mapping for Controls around audit logging, key management and retention. I need links to our evidence (audit log retention policy, KMS/HSM access controls, and any incident logs). @Jordan Oncall can you attach the HSM proxy logs and eventIDs?
Jordan Oncall: Uploading relevant log slices now to the incident bundle (link: https://rwd/infra/logs/incident-1772501234) — slice covers 08:12-08:30 UTC. I see KMS service emitted events but the audit-exporter had a partial failure pushing to the export endpoint; backlog was repaired at 08:40. That explains missing entries in customer's exported CSV between ~08:15-08:25.
Alex Support: Workaround for customer: 1) rotate API key (short term); 2) request retry logic on 5xx; 3) we can pull and provide the missing audit events as a one-off export while exporter backlog is being reviewed.
Maya AM: Customer is on Dedicated plan with SLA. Prioritize — they'll want a written remediation timeline and ISO27001 mapping ASAP. I'll coordinate the compliance packet request.
Priya Security: For ISO27001 mapping, I'll start assembling controls: A.12.4 (logging), A.10.1 (cryptographic controls), A.8.1/A.8.2 (asset & access). I'll need: - configuration of audit-exporter, retention period (we default to 365 days for audit logs, export TTL=30 days), - proof of HSM/KMS access control (ACLs, rotation policy), - evidence of incident and remediation (traces, backlog repair). Please add export CSV and HSM ACL snapshot to the packet.
Alex Support: Attached quick reproduction + minimal logs to the thread bundle. Also note the billing spike: looks like a burst of retries caused additional token fetches which incremented billable token count for the customer's private endpoint. Jordan, can you confirm billing correlate?
Jordan Oncall: Confirmed — billing events show a burst of token fetches and failed request retries between 08:16-08:22 that spiked usage meter. I'll include meter lines in the bundle.
incident-bot: Alert 177250-API-ERR acknowledged by @Jordan Oncall at 2026-03-15T09:05:00Z.
Maya AM: I'll send customer an interim note: we acknowledge impact, investigating root cause, will deliver missing audit records and ISO27001 evidence pack within 48 hours.
Priya Security: I'll draft a compliance memo mapping the controls and include the exported events + HSM ACL snapshot. Expect initial draft in ~24h.
Alex Support: Thanks team — tagging follow-ups: @Priya Security for ISO mapping, @Jordan Oncall for logs & billing correlation, @Maya AM for customer comms. :thumbsup:
Acme Ops (customer): Appreciate the quick triage. We'll standby for the export and the compliance packet.
_notes: Thread contains root + replies, short slack-style messages, inline code blocks and a link to internal bundles.
